analysis: The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied units are BASE text, lines 420-1216, of the Nemotron Super and GLM5Next documentation. The head-side additions (the Gemma 4 tensor-parallel section and the cluster placement text) appear only as a truncated patch excerpt, so I could not review them. The BASE text is unchanged context. No code, configuration, crypto, authorization or attestation logic changes in the visible portion. The BASE text describes the encrypted SSD prefix-cache checkpoints, partitioned by an authenticated cache scope, which relates to T-041, A-001 and TB-007. It also describes admission, memory budgeting and wedge retirement, which relate to the availability threats T-029 and T-010. None of those statements are modified in the visible hunks. The visible diff changes only the 'Last updated' date, adds a Gemma tensor-parallel exemption sentence and a source path rename, and adds a large Gemma 4 tensor-parallel section whose full text was not supplied. Remaining questions for integration: whether the new Gemma 4 tensor-parallel and cluster section introduces inter-Mac traffic (cluster links carrying activations, i.e. A-001 plaintext) with undocumented authentication or encryption. That would be a trust boundary the current threat model does not cover. The accompanying code changes (TensorParallelSwitchLinear, cluster placement) are not in this batch. I cannot conclude they are safe, and the truncated patch is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety.
